Rashi on Niddah 72a:10:1.english: To be stringent - [This is] by Rabbinic decree.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:10:2.english: To be lenient - [In] bringing unconsecrated [animals] into the [Temple] courtyard.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:13:1.hebrew: אמר רב הונא משכבות ומושבות שבשני - לראייתה. הרואה תוך י"א וטבלה יום שלאחריו, לב"ש דמחמירי ומטמאין משכב ומושב מדרבנן לאחר טבילה, ואפילו לא ראתה — מאי טעמא? דכיון דכי חזיא מטמאה למפרע מדאורייתא, שהרי מצטרף לזיבה, כי לא חזיא נמי גזרינן מדרבנן אטו ראתה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:13:1.english: Rav Huna said: Items designated for lying and sitting on the second [day] - [That is,] relative to her sighting. [In the case of] a woman who sees [blood] during the eleven [days of zivah] and immersed on the day following it, according to Beit Shammai, who are stringent and declare [her] items designated for lying and sitting impure by rabbinic law after immersion, even if she did not see [blood again]—what is the reason? Since if she sees [blood again], she transmits impurity retroactively by Torah law, for it combines for zivah, when she does not see [blood again] as well, we decree by rabbinic law on account of [the case where] she saw.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:14:1.hebrew: תנינא טבלה יום שלאחריו - יום י"ב שאינו מצטרף, ואחר כן ראתה. וקס"ד: האי ראתה דלאחריו כאילו לא ראתה תוך י"א דמיא, דהא עכשיו היא מטמאה מתחילת נדה ואינה פוסלת טבילה של שחרית. והך טומאה מדרבנן היא, דגזרינן י"ב אטו י"א; ה"נ גזרינן לא ראתה אטו ראתה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:14:1.english: We have learned: She immersed on the day following it - [This refers to] the twelfth day, which does not combine [for zivah], and afterward she saw [blood]. And [Rav Yosef] assumed: This [case where] she saw [blood] on the day following it is comparable to as if she did not see [blood] within the eleven [days], for now she becomes impure from the beginning of niddah and it does not invalidate [her] morning immersion. And this impurity is rabbinic, as we decree [the] twelfth [day] on account of [the] eleven [days]; so too, we decree [a case where] she did not see [blood] on account of [a case where] she saw [blood].

Rashi on Niddah 72a:16:1.hebrew: ראיית נדה היא - ואינה מצטרפת, אלא מעכשיו מטמאה, וטומאת מעת לעת הוא דאיכא עליה, וטומאת מעת לעת אינה מטמאה את בועלה. אלא משום דגזרינן יום שלאחר י"א אטו תוך י"א דאורייתא, ה"נ תוך י"א, כי לא ראתה בשני אחר טבילתה, גזרינן אטו ראתה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:16:1.english: It is a sighting of a niddah - And it does not combine [with the previous day's sighting to create zivah]; rather, [by Torah law,] she transmits impurity [only] from now on. And it is only the impurity of twenty-four hours that applies to her [retroactively], and the impurity of twenty-four hours does not render her partner in intercourse impure. Rather, [it is] because we decree [concerning] the day after the eleven [days] due to [a sighting] within the eleven [days], which is by Torah law; so too, within the eleven [days], when she did not see [blood] on the second [day] after her immersion, we decree due to [the case where] she did see [blood].

Rashi on Niddah 72a:17:1.hebrew: א"ל אביי לרב יוסף רב כהנא - דאמר "ראתה שאני", הכי קא קשיא ליה: אע"ג דהך טומאה מדרבנן, ליכא למימר דכי היכי דגזרי ב"ש ראייה שניה דלאחר י"א אטו ראייה שניה תוך י"א, ה"נ נגזור לא ראתה אטו ראתה; דראייה בראייה מיחלפא, ראתה בלא ראתה לא מיחלפא:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:17:1.english: Abaye said to Rav Yosef: Rav Kahana - [As for Rav Kahana,] who said, "Seeing [blood] is different," this is what was difficult for him: Even though this impurity is rabbinic, one cannot say that just as Beit Shammai decreed regarding a second sighting after the eleven [days] on account of a second sighting within the eleven [days], so too we should decree [where] she did not see on account of [where] she saw; for a sighting may be confused with a sighting, [but a case where] she saw is not confused with [a case where] she did not see.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:18:1.english: And furthermore, we learned - Which is not in accordance with Rav Huna.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:18:2.english: One who sees one sighting of zov - [The mishna] is dealing with a man.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:18:3.hebrew: כשומרת יום כנגד יום - בשני שלה, שמגעה תלוי אחר טבילה, אף זה מגעו תלוי: אם טבל לאחר ראייה ונגע במעשר, מגעו תלוי, שמא יראה ראייה שניה ומצטרף לזיבה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:18:3.english: Like a woman who observes a day for a day - On her second day, when [the status of] that which she touches is suspended after immersion, so too with this [man], [the status of] that which he touches is suspended: If he immersed after the sighting and touched tithes, [the status of] that which he touched is suspended, lest he see a second sighting and it combine for zivah.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:18:4.english: Like one who experienced a seminal emission - And he is pure for tithes immediately after immersion. In any event, it teaches that according to Beit Shammai, a woman who observes a day [against a day] and a zav with a first sighting are equal.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:1:1.hebrew: וב"ה פוטרין מן הקרבן - דלא בעי שימור. אבל לענין טומאה מודו מדרבנן להחמיר, גזרה יום י"א אטו תוך י"א יום, דמטמאה בועלה מדאורייתא עד שתספור קצת יום המחרת, כדיליף לקמן מיהיה לה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:1:1.english: And Beit Hillel exempt [them] from the offering - For [the eleventh day] does not require observation [of a clean day]. But with regard to ritual impurity, they concede that rabbinically [one is] to be stringent, [as] a decree [regarding] the eleventh day on account of [a day] within the eleven days, for she renders one who has intercourse with her ritually impure by Torah law until she counts part of the following day, as [the Gemara] derives later from "it shall be to her".

Rashi on Niddah 72a:2:1.hebrew: טבלה יום שלאחריו - דעבדה שימור קצת, ושימור מעליא הוא, אלא שתוך י"א יום אסור לעשות כן, שלא תבא לידי ספק שמא תראה לאחר תשמיש, ומצטרפין הימים לזיבה, ואין טבילתה טבילה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:2:1.english: She immersed on the day following it - For she performed partial guarding [of a clean day], and it is a proper guarding; however, within the eleven days [of zivah], it is forbidden to do so, so that she does not come into doubt lest she see [blood] after intercourse, and the days combine for zivah, and her immersion will not be a [valid] immersion.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:2:2.hebrew: מטמאין משכב ומושב - ואפילו בועלה, מדרבנן, גזרו אטו תוך י"א יום:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:2:2.english: They transmit impurity to [items for] lying and sitting - And [this includes] even the one who had intercourse with her; [this is] by rabbinic law, [for the Sages] decreed [this] due to [a case occurring] within the eleven days.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:2:3.hebrew: ופטורין מן הקרבן - דהא עבדי שימור, ואע"פ שחזרה וראתה, אין מצטרפין לזיבה, שהרי תחילת נדה היא:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:2:3.english: And they are exempt from the offering - For they performed [the required] guarding, and even though she saw [blood] again, [the days] do not combine toward ziva, as it is the beginning of [the] nidda [period].

Rashi on Niddah 72a:3:1.hebrew: גרגרן - ממהר לחטוא, שמא ירגיל בכך תוך י"א, אבל לענין טומאה טהור:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:3:1.english: A glutton - [He is] hasty to sin, lest he become accustomed to [doing] this within the eleven [days], but with regard to ritual impurity, [he is] pure.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:3:2.hebrew: וחייבין בקרבן - ואפילו לא תראה למחר, דהא בעי שימור, והרי בעל זבה קטנה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:3:2.english: And they are liable to a sacrifice - And even if she does not see [blood] the next day; for this requires watching [a clean day], and behold, he had relations with a minor zavah.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:4:1.english: She immersed on the day following it - Where she performed a partial watching and engaged in marital relations.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:4:2.english: This is improper conduct - Lest she see [blood] afterward and it combine with [the discharge] before it, and her immersion will not be a [valid] immersion.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:4:3.english: And their contact - With regard to ritual impurity and purity.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:4:4.english: And their intercourse - [Is contingent] with regard to a sacrifice.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:4:5.hebrew: תלויין - שאם תראה, מגען מגע זבה וחייבין בקרבן, ואם לא תראה, מגען טהור ובעילתן פטורה:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:4:5.english: Suspended - That if she sees [blood], what they touched has the status of contact with a zava and they are liable for a sacrifice; and if she does not see [blood], what they touched is pure and their intercourse is exempt [from a sacrifice].

Rashi on Niddah 72a:5:1.hebrew: ת"ר ושוין בטובלת לילה לזבה - ואע"פ שחלוקין ב"ה ברואה יום י"א וטבלה לערב שפטורין מן הקרבן, התם משום דיום י"א לא בעי שימור, הילכך לאו זבה הואי. אבל זבה קטנה של תוך י"א יום בעיא שימור, דאין טבילת לילה עולה עד שתשמור יום המחרת קצת ותטבול:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:5:1.english: The Sages taught: And they agree with regard to one who immerses at night for a zava - And even though Beit Hillel disagree regarding [a woman] who sees [blood on] the eleventh day and immersed in the evening, [holding] that they are exempt from the offering, there [it is] because the eleventh day does not require watching [a clean day]; therefore, she was not a zava. However, a minor zava within the eleven days requires watching [a clean day], for an immersion at night does not count until she watches part of the following day and immerses.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:5:2.english: And they agree with regard to a woman who sees [blood] within the eleven days, and immersed in the evening and engaged in intercourse, that they are liable to a sacrifice - [It is] as though he had intercourse with her during the day. And this latter clause is an explanation of the first clause.

Rashi on Niddah 72a:7:1.hebrew: אם שיוה לו לטומאה - שאתם מודים שמטמאה בועלה, משכב ומושב, ליל מוצאי י"א:
Rashi on Niddah 72a:7:1.english: If it equated it to it with regard to impurity - For you admit that she defiles her intercourse partner, couch, and seat on the night following the eleventh [day].

Rashi on Niddah 72a:8:1.english: In the midst of the eleven [days, the following day] combines with it for zivah - Therefore, she must observe the following day corresponding to the day of the sighting.

Tosafot on Niddah 72a:11:1.hebrew: אף אתם השוו מדותיכם - וא"ת: ומאי ס"ד דב"ש, הא ודאי לדידהו נמי איכא לאקשויי הכי? וי"ל, דקסברי ב"ש: דיום י"א, שהוא מדאורייתא, אי מחמירינן ביה לטמא משכב ומושב, אתי למימר ביה חיוב קרבן; אבל ביום שלאחריו, שהכל יודעין שהוא מדרבנן, לא אתי לחיובי קרבן אי מחמירין ביה לטמויי משכב ומושב:
Tosafot on Niddah 72a:11:1.english: You too, apply your measures equally - And if you say: What was the initial thinking of Beit Shammai, for surely against them as well this [same challenge] can certainly be raised? And one can say [in reply] that Beit Shammai maintained that [regarding] the eleventh day, which is Biblical, if we are stringent regarding it to defile bed and seat (mishkav u-moshav), people will come to assert regarding it an obligation to bring an offering; but on the day following it, which everyone knows is [only] Rabbinic, people will not come to obligate an offering if we are stringent regarding it to defile bed and seat.

Tosafot on Niddah 72a:15:1.hebrew: אמר רב כהנא ראתה שאני - ואדרבה, מנליה לרב הונא בתוך י"א יום בלא ראתה? והיינו דקאמר: ״רב כהנא הכי קא קשיא ליה״, פי' אדרב הונא. ועוד, תניא דלא כרב הונא:
Tosafot on Niddah 72a:15:1.english: Rav Kahana said: Seeing [blood] is different - And on the contrary, from where does Rav Huna derive [his ruling regarding a case] within the eleven days when she did not see [blood]? And that is why [Abaye] said: "This is what was difficult for Rav Kahana" — meaning, [an objection] against Rav Huna. And furthermore, it is taught [in a Baraita] not in accordance with Rav Huna.
